title: Luti Paak Rasool Di Aal
body:
Luti Paak Rasool Di Aal Tapdiyan Raitan Te.
<<DIVIDER>>
Hoya Chan Zahra Pamal (x2) Tapdiyan Raitan Te.
<<DIVIDER>>
Logon Bibi Zahra Sani Pakh Batool Di Pakh Nishani (x2)
Khari Ban Vich Khol Ke Waal (x2) Tapdiyan Raitan Te.
<<DIVIDER>>
Dadha Ummat Zulm Kamaya Pyasay Gal Te Teer Chalaya (x2)
Hy Maarya Asghar Baal(x2) Tapdiyan Raitan Te.
<<DIVIDER>>
Wul Wul Akhay Zahra Jaya Dhup Taay Unnay Daeraa Laya (x2)
Aa Vehk Rubab Da Haal (x2) Tapdiyan Raitan Te.
<<DIVIDER>>
Behnaa Kharyan Rassiyan Paa Kay Kyon Nahi Murya Nahar Tay Ja Kay (x2)
Aa Umal Baneen Da Laal (x2) Tapdiyan Raitan Te.
<<DIVIDER>>
Kalla Alam Hai Khaimay Aaya Chacha Ghazi Kyun Nahin Aaya (x2)
Eho Pyasay Karan Sawal(x2) Tapdiyan Raitan Te.
<<DIVIDER>>
Chan Qasim Di Rul Gayi Mehndi Tupdi Rait Tay Dhul Gayi Mehndi (x2)
Maa Vaikhdi Hasrat Naal (x2) Tapdiyan Raitan Te.
<<DIVIDER>>
Jhunya Akbar Barchi Kha Kay Pak Hussain Musafir Aakhay (x2)
Hy Ujariya Hussan Jamal (x2) Tapdiyan Raitan Te.
<<DIVIDER>>
Behnaa Tur Kay Shaam Nu Jana Teray Lashay Nay Rah Jana (x2)
Lujpaalan Da Lujpaal (x2) Tapdiyan Raitan Te.
<<DIVIDER>>
Veera Apna Qoaul Nibehsan Tera Chelum Aan Kerisan (x2)
Aawaan Gee Aglay Saal (x2) Tapdiyan Raitan Te
<<DIVIDER>>
Eh Tauqeer Ki Dard Sunaway Ki Abid Da Haal Vekahway (x2)
Jadon Turya Bairiyan Naal (x2) Tapdiyan Raitan Te.
